newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 10.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Far right party National Front wins control of a fourth southern town, for the first time with an absolute majority.
-- Further strikes without notice are not ruled out at Air France Europe, formerly Air Inter, as staff protest against conditions of planned merger with Air France.
-- Compagnie des Signaux to bid for CEA stake in computer services group Cisi.
-- Former UAP executive Dominique Bazy to leave Axa -UAP for Allianz.
